svg.title: Rust eBPF XDP IP Reputation Firewall Architecture
svg.desc: Dark-mode architecture diagram of a Rust control plane feeding eBPF maps used by an XDP firewall fast path, with FireHOL threat intelligence, static blocklists, RocksDB enrichment, ring-buffer events, and Prometheus telemetry.
svg.text: Rust eBPF / XDP IP Reputation Firewall
Rust control plane • FireHOL + static blocklists • atomic eBPF map updates • XDP fast path • enriched security events • Prometheus metrics
Tokio daemon orchestrating configuration, threat feeds, map synchronization, event handling and observability
Per-packet fast path: in-kernel lookups, drop events and low-overhead counters
Tokio async coordinator for all control-plane tasks
Loads sources, updates maps and exports telemetry
Scheduled fetch, parallel parsing and local zero-copy metadata cache
Local CIDR/IP files with automatic hot reload
Builds EXACT + LPM datasets from FireHOL and local rules
Applies atomic updates to keep XDP lookups consistent
No packet payload is copied into user space
Asynchronous event processing keeps packet handling independent from logging and metrics
Early packet decision before the regular Linux network stack
1. exact IP lookup → 2. CIDR LPM fallback → 3. emit drop event → 4. increment stats
Shared state used by XDP and synchronized atomically from user space
No match → packet continues through the normal network stack
NO PACKET COPY TO USER SPACE
